frontmatter.name: init
frontmatter.description: Triggers on first session when .ask-buddy/memory/profile.md does not exist. Also triggers when user says "重新初始化", "reset profile", "let me re-introduce myself", or "重新认识我". Guides the user through a friendly onboarding conversation to establish their profile and preferences.

frontmatter.name: instincts
frontmatter.description: User behavior pattern recognition system. Auto-triggers when qa-guide Step 3 detects repeated behavior patterns. Also triggers manually on "我的习惯", "my patterns", "你觉得我喜欢什么", "instinct check", "行为分析", "你了解我吗", or "what do you know about me".

frontmatter.name: memory-sync
frontmatter.description: Updates Ask Buddy's persistent memory files. Auto-triggers when a conversation has produced substantive findings or conclusions, when 10+ substantive exchanges have occurred, when the user switches topics, or when user preferences change. Also triggers manually when user says "记一下", "save this", "更新记忆", "remember this", "总结一下", "summarize our chat", "存个档", or "save progress". Does NOT trigger on trivial greetings or single-question exchanges.

frontmatter.name: qa-guide
frontmatter.description: Use when the user asks any question — about code logic, Jira cards, Confluence documents, technical concepts, architecture, or general knowledge. Triggers on "what does this do", "how does X work", "explain Y", ticket numbers (PROJ-123), "tell me about", "上次聊的那个", or any request for explanation or summary.

frontmatter.description: "Autonomous business process analyst agent that deeply analyzes provided business documents, transcripts, or descriptions to extract structured process information."
frontmatter.whenToUse:
|
  Use this agent when the user provides a large amount of existing business material (meeting transcripts, existing process documents, SOP manuals, or lengthy business descriptions) and needs it analyzed and structured into the biz-interview session format. This agent works autonomously to extract L1/L2/L3 processes, documents, roles, systems, pain points, and opportunities without requiring interactive dialogue.

  <example>
  Context: User pastes a long meeting transcript
  user: "这是我们上次需求评审会的录音转录，帮我分析一下里面的业务流程"
  assistant: "I'll use the process-analyst agent to analyze this transcript and extract structured process information."
  <commentary>
  User has existing material that needs autonomous deep analysis, not interactive interview.
  </commentary>
  </example>

  <example>
  Context: User provides existing SOP document
  user: "这是我们现有的采购流程SOP文档，帮我结构化整理出来"
  assistant: "I'll use the process-analyst agent to structure this SOP into our standard format."
  <commentary>
  Existing document needs restructuring into L1/L2/L3 framework.
  </commentary>
  </example>

  <example>
  Context: User describes a complex business scenario in one long message
  user: "我们公司的报销流程是这样的：首先员工在OA系统提交报销申请......（一大段描述）"
  assistant: "I'll use the process-analyst agent to analyze this business process description."
  <commentary>
  Long single-message description that's better handled by autonomous analysis than interactive Q&A.
  </commentary>
  </example>

frontmatter.description: "Generate data flow diagrams showing how data and documents move between systems, roles, and processes. Use when the user says 'data flow', 'data diagram', '数据流转图', '数据流向', '系统交互图', '表证单书流转'."
"Extract and organize a business glossary/terminology table from interview findings. Use when the user says 'glossary', 'terminology', '术语表', '生成术语表', '概念定义', '名词解释'."

"Start a structured business process interview session. Use when the user wants to conduct a business process discovery interview, map L1/L2/L3 processes, identify pain points and opportunities, or says 'start interview', 'business process interview', '开始访谈', '业务流程梳理', '流程访谈'."
frontmatter.argument-hint: "[业务领域/主题，如：采购流程、客户服务]"

frontmatter.description: "Master orchestrator for business process discovery — automatically routes to the right workflow based on user intent. Use when the user mentions business process analysis, process discovery, wants to do an interview, has material to analyze, needs a report, or says '业务流程', '流程梳理', '访谈', '分析流程', '生成报告', '全套输出'. This is the primary entry point for the biz-interview plugin."
frontmatter.argument-hint: "[intent or topic, e.g. '开始访谈 采购流程' or '分析这份文档']"

"Research and enrich interview findings with external knowledge — industry best practices, benchmark processes, and terminology validation. Use when the user says 'research', 'enrich', '调研补充', '外网检索', '补充认知', '行业对标', or after generating an initial interview report."

frontmatter.name: bug-diagnostician
frontmatter.description:
>
  Deep root-cause analysis agent. Reads issue context, source code, and tests
  to produce a precise diagnosis with fix strategy. Spawned by the diagnose skill.
  Read-only — does NOT modify any files.
frontmatter.whenToUse:
|
  Triggered by the issue-fixer orchestrator at Step 4 (diagnose) to perform
  deep root-cause analysis of a bug reported in a GitHub Issue.

  Examples:
    - "Analyze why the login handler returns 500 when email contains +"
    - "Trace the null pointer path in response parsing"
    - "Identify the root cause of timeout not being respected in retry logic"

frontmatter.name: fix-reviewer
frontmatter.description:
>
  Adversarial code reviewer for generated fixes. Checks whether the fix
  addresses the root cause, could introduce regressions, handles edge cases,
  and is minimal. Spawned by the verify-fix skill after changes are applied.
frontmatter.whenToUse:
|
  Triggered by the issue-fixer orchestrator at Step 6 (verify-fix) to perform
  adversarial review of the generated code fix diff.

  Examples:
    - "Review whether this fix actually addresses the null pointer root cause"
    - "Check if this change could break other callers of the modified function"
    - "Evaluate if the regression test adequately covers the bug scenario"

frontmatter.name: mrd-gap-analyst
frontmatter.description: Use this agent when mrd-compare needs to perform deep A/B reasoning chain comparison. Takes two trace documents and produces a structured gap report with severity ratings and gap sizes (small/large) for each identified difference across 8 analysis dimensions.

frontmatter.name: mrd-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Use this agent when mrd-optimize has a confirmed optimization plan and needs to execute file modifications on the target plugin. Handles both prompt additions (small gaps) and heavy inference-time compute strategy integration (MCTS, LATS, Tournament, Self-Consistency patterns for large gaps). Only operates after user confirmation.

frontmatter.name: mrd-trace-reconstructor
frontmatter.description: Use this agent when MRD needs to reconstruct one observable Claude/Agent/model run from transcript, JSON/JSONL logs, tool call records, context snapshots, compaction summaries, or a run directory into canonical trace artifacts. Best for large logs or parallel A/B trace reconstruction before comparison. Never recover hidden chain-of-thought.

frontmatter.name: mrd
frontmatter.description: MRD 路由入口。识别用户意图并路由到三个核心技能之一：mrd-trace（扫描推理链路）、mrd-compare（对比推理链路差异）、mrd-optimize（优化 plugin）。用户说"分析推理方式"、"比较模型差异"、"优化插件效果"、"提升弱模型"或直接使用 /mrd 时触发。

frontmatter.name: mrd-capture-plan
frontmatter.description: 当用户的材料不足以进行推理链路重建时（T0 等级），生成结构化的下一次采集计划，说明应该采集哪些 tool call、context snapshot、compaction pre/post 和验证结果才能达到 T2/T3 可观测性。用户说"材料不够怎么办"、"下次跑时该记录什么"、"怎么采集才能审计"、"设计采集方案"时使用。
frontmatter.argument-hint: "[可选：当前已有材料的描述或路径]"

frontmatter.name: mrd-compare
frontmatter.description: 对比两份推理链路文档（A 模型 vs B 模型），按八个维度做语义对齐和差异分析，输出结构化差异报告。用户说"对比推理链路"、"比较 A 和 B"、"找出差异"、"分析差距"时使用。

frontmatter.name: mrd-evolve
frontmatter.description: 对目标 skill 执行自动进化搜索——基于 GEPA（遗传进化 prompt 优化）生成多个变异体，自动评估筛选，迭代收敛到最优版本。用户说"自动进化"、"evolve skill"、"迭代优化"、"自动搜索最优 prompt"、"进化这个 skill"时使用。

frontmatter.name: mrd-optimize
frontmatter.description: 基于推理链路差异报告，为目标 plugin 生成优化方案并在用户确认后执行。小差距追加提示词约束，大差距引入 MCTS 验证-修复循环、LATS 树搜索、锦标赛/联赛聚合或 Self-Consistency 多数投票等重型策略。用户说"优化插件"、"修复差距"、"提升效果"、"apply 优化"时使用。

frontmatter.name: mrd-parity-eval
frontmatter.description: 基于 2×2 Model×Harness 多 trial 实验结果，判断 harness upgrade 是否 go、是否达到 scoped behavioral parity、以及是否存在 model-intrinsic residual。用户说"判断是否 parity"、"分析 factorial 实验"、"harness upgrade 是否 go"、"验证效果"、"是否达到对齐"时使用。

frontmatter.name: mrd-quick-eval
frontmatter.description: 从已有 trace 和差异报告中自动提取 golden case 构建回归测试集，支持优化迭代时快速验证 skill 变体是否退化。用户说"快速验证"、"回归测试"、"跑 quick eval"、"验证没退化"、"优化前先测"时使用。

frontmatter.name: mrd-trace
frontmatter.description: 给定一个需求或任务，让当前模型完整执行一遍（或从已有日志中提取），捕获完整的可观测推理链路。输出规范化的 trace 文档，包含任务理解、分解策略、上下文选择、工具使用、状态更新、验证方式和最终输出的完整链路。用户说"扫描推理链路"、"捕获思考过程"、"记录推理方式"、"trace 当前模型"时使用。
frontmatter.argument-hint: "<需求描述 或 日志/transcript 路径>"

plugins.name: sad

frontmatter.name: sad-designer
frontmatter.description:
>
  Use this agent when the design skill needs to generate a complete Software
  Architecture Design document from a prepared context document. The agent
  produces AsciiDoc SAD, source-reference traceability, and Draw.io-authored SVG diagrams.

  Trigger scenarios:
  (1) The design skill has a completed <module>-context.md and needs SAD artifacts produced.
  (2) A review iteration returned fix items and the SAD needs targeted corrections.
  (3) The orchestrator needs specific sections regenerated after clarification.

  <example>
  Context: The as-is document is ready and the pipeline advances to design.
  user: "Generate the SAD for the diagnostic module based on diagnostic-context.md."
  assistant: "I will use the sad-designer agent to produce the SAD artifacts from the context document."
  <commentary>
  Context document exists. Agent produces SAD, ref file, and SVG diagrams.
  </commentary>
  </example>

  <example>
  Context: Review found issues that need fixing in the SAD.
  user: "Fix these issues in the SAD: missing interface contract for IF-02, ADR-003 has no alternatives."
  assistant: "I will use the sad-designer agent to apply targeted fixes to the SAD artifacts."
  <commentary>
  Specific fix instructions. Agent reads current SAD, applies corrections, rewrites affected sections.
  </commentary>
  </example>

  <example>
  Context: User clarified missing information and the context doc was updated.
  user: "The context document now includes the CAN bus timing constraints. Regenerate the Runtime View."
  assistant: "I will use the sad-designer agent to regenerate the affected sections."
  <commentary>
  Partial regeneration after new information. Agent updates specific sections.
  </commentary>
  </example>

frontmatter.name: sad-reviewer
frontmatter.description:
>
  Use this agent when the review skill needs to perform dimensional quality
  analysis on a SAD document. This agent is instantiated multiple times with
  different dimension-specific prompts injected by the review skill.

  Trigger scenarios:
  (1) The review skill creates parallel instances for document and diagram quality dimensions.
  (2) A re-review is needed after fixes were applied.
  (3) A specific dimension needs deeper analysis.

  <example>
  Context: Review skill launches traceability dimension check.
  user: "Review the diagnostic SAD for traceability completeness. Check that every claim has a source reference."
  assistant: "I will use the sad-reviewer agent to analyze traceability coverage."
  <commentary>
  The review skill injects the traceability dimension prompt. Agent checks evidence chain.
  </commentary>
  </example>

  <example>
  Context: Review skill launches consistency dimension check.
  user: "Review the diagnostic SAD for naming consistency across text, diagrams, and tables."
  assistant: "I will use the sad-reviewer agent to verify cross-reference alignment."
  <commentary>
  The review skill injects the consistency dimension prompt. Agent checks naming.
  </commentary>
  </example>

  <example>
  Context: Review skill launches quality dimension after fixes.
  user: "Re-check the SAD content quality after the designer applied fixes."
  assistant: "I will use the sad-reviewer agent to verify content quality standards."
  <commentary>
  Post-fix re-review. Agent checks content substance meets standards.
  </commentary>
  </example>
